clauses.clause: Target creature you control gets +X/+X until end of turn.
clauses.evidence: Target slot 1..1 of [you_bear, you_giant] only. X=0/1/3: you_bear 2/2 unchanged / 3/3 / 5/5, you_giant 4/4 / 5/5 / 7/7; after the turn ends back to printed size. Cost G-1 plus X generic (W-0/W-1/W-3).

clauses.clause: Then it fights up to one target creature you don't control. (Each deals damage equal to its power to the other.)
clauses.evidence: Second slot 0..1 of [opp_flier, opp_tapped, opp_bear, opp_giant] only. [X=3 you_bear, opp_flier]: opp_flier dealt 5 (pumped power), you_bear dealt 1; [X=1 you_bear, opp_tapped]: both dealt 3, both die; [X=0 you_giant, opp_giant]: both dealt 4, both die; [targets=['you_bear']] alone: pump only, no fight.
